{"metadata":{"description":"Run any agent loop engine on dsh — the built-in in-process loop, Claude Code, Codex, or Pi — chosen per session, all sharing dsh's own session store, message format, model routing, and tracing.","id":"gh:1353726373","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-omniloop","slug":"vidgewong/dsh-omniloop","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Run any agent loop engine on dsh — the built-in in-process loop, Claude Code, Codex, or Pi — chosen "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"per session, all sharing dsh's own session store, message format, model routing, and tracing."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-omniloop"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> **Claude Code, Codex, Pi and dsh's built-in loop — side by side in one dsh.
> Pick the engine per "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"session. No restart, no global switch.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Run any agent loop engine on **dsh** — the built-in in-process loop, Claude
Code, Codex, or Pi — **c"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"hosen per session**, all sharing dsh's own session
store, message format, model routing, and tracing"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"osen per session**, all sharing dsh's own session
store, message format, model routing, and tracing."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Pick an engine the way you pick a model: in the composer, when you start a
session. The session you "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"are in keeps running on the engine it was created
with. No restart, no global switch, no interrupted"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" keeps running on the engine it was created
with. No restart, no global switch, no interrupted work."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why a router"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"dsh admits exactly one `AgentFactory` for the whole process. That single slot
is what forced every e"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"arlier approach to be a *global* choice: to run Claude
Code you had to disable the base loop, and ev"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ery session in the profile moved
with you."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"This plugin takes that slot and turns it into a router. It holds one factory
per engine — including "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"dsh's own in-process loop, mounted as a first-class
engine rather than replaced — and dispatches eac"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"h `createAgent` / `resume` call
to the engine that session belongs to."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Everything above the router stays dsh's. Each engine's native output is
translated into dsh's `Messa"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ge` / `ContentBlock` / `StreamChunk` types, so
sessions from different engines are stored, streamed,"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" resumed, and traced
identically."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Engine affinity is durable"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"A session's engine is recorded when it is created and travels with it. Resuming
a session restores i"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"t to the engine that produced its history — not to whatever
is currently selected. This matters beca"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"use engine session logs carry different
provenance (a Codex-driven session records `provider = 'code"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"x'`), and replaying
that history under another engine would hand the model a transcript it cannot
ac"},{"id":"p12s5","text":" and replaying
that history under another engine would hand the model a transcript it cannot
act on."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Forked sessions and subagents inherit the parent's engine."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Restart `dsh web` once after installing. After that, engine selection is
runtime state — switching n"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ever requires a restart again."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"> **Coming from `@vidge/dsh-agent-hub`?** Same plugin, new name. Remove the old
> package first so b"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"oth never claim the factory slot:
>

> Existing sessions keep their recorded engine — the sidecar format is unchanged."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"> Installing writes a small managed block into the profile's
> `cordis.patch.yml`, disabling the bun"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"dle's own `agent-loop` row so the router

> that file is preserved byte for byte."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Engine dependencies"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Each engine's SDK is an **optional peer** — installing this plugin pulls in the
router only. Add the"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" engines you actually want, into **the same profile**:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Two details matter, and getting either wrong looks like a plugin bug:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **Install through `dsh plugin ... add`, not a bare `pnpm add`.** The SDK has to
land in the profil"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"e that runs dsh (`~/.dsh/profiles/<name>`). A `pnpm add` in
some other directory installs a package "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"the host will never resolve.
- **Pin the version this release declares.** The versions above are the"},{"id":"p24s4","text":" exact
`peerDependencies` entries of this package; the SDK message vocabularies are
not stable acros"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"s minors, and a drifting version is not a supported
configuration."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Because profiles set `autoInstallPeers: false`, an optional peer is only ever
present if some packag"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"e explicitly depends on it. Installing it as a direct
profile dependency (which the command above do"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"es) records it in the profile's
lockfile, so later installs and upgrades keep it. An SDK that is mer"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"ely *present*
in `node_modules` without being depended on is an orphan, and the next
`pnpm install` "},{"id":"p25s5","text":"in that profile will prune it — after which the engine reports the
package as missing."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The `in-process` engine needs nothing beyond dsh itself, so a profile that
installs no SDK at all st"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ocess` engine needs nothing beyond dsh itself, so a profile that
installs no SDK at all still works."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Selecting an engine whose SDK is missing fails that turn with a message naming
the package to instal"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"l; it never affects other sessions or engines."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### Authentication"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Only for the engines you use:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- **Claude Code** — credentials are derived from dsh's own LLM provider
configuration (see below); a"},{"id":"p30s2","text":" CLI login is a fallback, not a requirement.
- **Codex** — authenticated via `codex login`, or a `CO"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"DEX_API_KEY` entry.
- **Pi** — authenticated the way `pi` expects: its own `~/.pi/agent/auth.json`,
"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"or the provider's API-key environment variable."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Choose an engine in the composer when starting a session. To change engines,
start a new session — t"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"he current one keeps its engine, and anything still
running on it is undisturbed."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"**Settings → Loop engine** sets the default for new sessions and controls
whether the composer picke"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"→ Loop engine** sets the default for new sessions and controls
whether the composer picker is shown."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"To remove the plugin:"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"Then restart `dsh web`."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Model and credential routing"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"For the Claude Code engine, the child process's provider environment is derived
from dsh's own LLM c"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"onfiguration rather than inherited from the shell that
launched the host. The selected model names a"},{"id":"p38s3","text":" provider route; the plugin reads
that route's endpoint from `llm-pi-ai` settings, resolves its key "},{"id":"p38s4","text":"through dsh's
`credentials` service, and states the result as the environment variables the
Agent SD"},{"id":"p38s5","text":"K understands — Bedrock (including behind a corporate gateway) and
native Anthropic endpoints."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"This is why a dsh started from a desktop launcher works: it inherits no
provider variables, but it d"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"oes not need to. dsh already knows the answer."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
